title: Breakout vs Fakeout
briefing: Harborline Shipping and Kestrel Air have both been boxed in for weeks, and Tidal Power keeps sliding. One breakout is coming on strong volume; the other is a quiet poke that will not last. Breakout Bea only trusts volume.
objective: Tell a confirmed breakout from a false one using the close and the volume.
debrief: Harborline crept above its range from day 4 on port-deal talk and light volume, slipped back when the talk cooled on day 12, then collapsed when the deal fell through on day 20: a false breakout that turned into a breakdown. On day 18 record bookings sent Kestrel Air through resistance on heavy volume, and it kept going. Tidal Power drifted lower all match with no breakout at all. A disciplined player skipped the quiet poke, bought the volume breakout and kept a stop back inside the old range.
